title: ChatGPT hidden feature that builds anything fast
description: Yeh ChatGPT trick 99% logon ko nahi pata. Aaj try karo!
voice: Ruko... ChatGPT ka ek feature aisa hai jo tumhara aadha kaam khatam kar deta hai, aur logon ko pata hi nahi. Sun lo, last wala step sabse zaroori hai. ChatGPT kholo, upar Explore GPTs pe jaao. Yahan ready-made AI assistants milte hain, har kaam ke liye alag. Resume banana hai? Ek GPT hai. Presentation? Uske liye bhi. Apna kaam likho, aur woh expert AI sirf wahi kaam karega, bahut behtar quality me. Bonus tip... apni files upload karke usse personal banao. Bas teen minute me kaam done. Aise hi roz ek naya AI hack chahiye? AI Tadka ko abhi follow karo.
